name: Salt flat
notes: Bare salt crust in the centre with a thin ring of succulent halophytes (glasswort, iodine bush, seepweed) and saltgrass at the margins, greasewood and tamarisk on the outer rim; Bonneville/Death Valley playas, Saharan chotts, Central Asian sabkhas, Salar de Uyuni.

shrub.name: Iodine bush
shrub.source: Allenrolfea occidentalis, playa margins of the Great Basin and Mojave, succulent-jointed shrub 0.3-1.5 m — USDA PLANTS

shrub.name: Greasewood
shrub.source: Sarcobatus vermiculatus, outer rim of alkali flats, western N America, 1-2.5 m — USDA PLANTS

shrub.name: Shrubby seablite
shrub.source: Suaeda vera, Mediterranean and Saharan chotts and sabkhas, succulent-leaved shrub 0.3-1.2 m — Euro+Med PlantBase

shrub.name: Nitre bush
shrub.source: Nitraria retusa, Saharan and Arabian salt flats, spiny mound shrub 0.5-2 m with red berries — Kew POWO

shrub.name: Saltcedar
shrub.source: Tamarix ramosissima, Central Asian sabkha margins, 2-6 m — Flora of China

ground.name: Glasswort
ground.source: Salicornia europaea, succulent annual of salt pans and marshes across Eurasia and N America, 5-30 cm, reddens in autumn — Euro+Med PlantBase

ground.name: Saltgrass
ground.source: Distichlis spicata, salt-tolerant sod grass of playa and coastal salt flats in the Americas, 10-40 cm — USDA PLANTS

ground.name: Pickleweed
ground.source: Sarcocornia fruticosa, perennial glasswort of Mediterranean and Saharan salt flats, mat 20-80 cm — Euro+Med PlantBase

ground.name: Alkali heath
ground.source: Frankenia salina, alkali flats and salt marshes of California and Baja, low mat 10-40 cm — Jepson eFlora

ground.name: Halocnemum
ground.source: Halocnemum strobilaceum, dominant of Central Asian and N African sabkhas, jointed succulent cushion 10-50 cm — Flora of China
